podcast.body: This song became Andy Gibb's second number-one pop hit, reaching the top of the charts on March 4, 1978, which coincided with his last day as a teenager. Barry Gibb wrote the main part of the song, with Andy contributing the "thicker than water" portion of the title, and Barry also provided backup vocals. Joe Walsh played guitar on the track, which critics like Tom Bryan noted as hinting at the sound of the 1980s with its synthesizers and guitar work. "Love is thicker than water. That one takes me back. That song hit number one on the last day of Andy Gibb's teenage years on March 4, 1978."
